title: Galaxy Watch4 series (WearOS3) complications not working in follower/broadcast mode
body:
This is tested on Galaxy Watch4 classic. 
If I'm using the "xDrip+ complication provider" it always shows "null / null" or "/null". 
I'm using build-your-own-dexcom-app to recieve my values, xDrip+ datasource is set to "640G/Eversense". 
All default xDrip+ watchfaces are working fine just the complication provider isn't. As you can see on the pictures.

For "G6 Native" datasource everything works fine, but I need the Dexcom reports for my endo.
